sources.title: Kroma 0.3.1 hands-on: uncensored Krea 2 finetune… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: A Reddit user tested Kroma 0.3.1 (a Krea 2 finetune) and finds it better than Qwen 2.1 and Krea2 overall. Highlights: uncensored, strong prompt following, good detail, wide style range, and notably free of the common body-horror artifacts. sources.title: Kroma v0.3: Krea 2 Fine-Tune Adds Full Base Checkpoint
sources.snippet: Lodestones ships Kroma v0.3 for Krea 2: a non-distilled full base checkpoint, a turbo variant, and a community LoRA pack that unlocks prompt following fixes.
